clips.title: The story
paras: In Raven Hill, Jitters is starving and afraid, with only weeds and insects to eat. He asks you to go east to Darkshire and seek a hot batch of Chef Grual’s famous Dusky Crab Cakes.

Raven Hill’s ruined streets shelter ravenous undead and lurking beasts. Jitters has hidden there for weeks, moving through its crumbling shanties under a sky that never seems to brighten. Grubs from the dirt and wild weeds are all he has found to eat. Hunger and fear wear him down, far from the comforts of ordinary life.

Jitters longs for a taste of safety: the seasoned patties made at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire. He asks you to cross the haunted road and speak with Chef Grual. If the chef agrees to make Dusky Crab Cakes, a hot meal may quiet Jitters’ growling gut.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I've been stuck hiding in this ghost town for weeks, and I haven't eaten anything but grubs and weeds! I need some decent food, and I'm willing to trade well for it.
Bring me a feast and I'll pay you handsomely.
I heard Chef Grual at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire makes very good Dusky Crab Cakes...

clips.title: Completion
paras: You need some Crab Cakes, do you? Well I might be able to cook some up for you...
